name: Prototype Pistol's [Class Bonus] On Enter +1 POWER buff
notes: Prototype Pistol is a REGALIA card: HandAddReplacement (GameLogic.php) silently redirects any REGALIA card added to hand via the BridgeAddToZone test-setup primitive into the material zone instead, so it can't be seeded to a known hand slot the usual way. That hook only fires for that kind of explicit single-card add, not the normal bulk initial deal, so a copy drawn into a real opening hand stays there normally -- player 2's natural 7-card opening hand happens to include one at myHand-0. Rule 1.h blocks only the opening player's own turn 1, so player 1 ends turn 1 with a single CustomInput Pass (no decision is pending, so this action itself ends the turn) and player 2 plays their naturally-drawn copy on turn 2, with a RANGER Class Bonus champion (Diana, Keen Huntress) already seeded onto their field.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Enter: Prototype Pistol gets +1 POWER until end of turn. (Apply this effect only if your champion's class matches this card's class.)
